column1: # The engine identity of each public release. One row = one release tag. The release tooling adds the row of each new tag.
# engine_tree: sha256 of the sorted (path, git blob) list of engine/, without engine/cli/version.h and *.md.
# kind: fix = a release that fixes a public issue (its blocks may be one engine change behind); release = every other release.
# Rows v0.22.0 to v0.38.1: from the public tags (git ls-tree -r <tag> -- engine; date = the tag date). kind fix = a patch release whose changelog thanks an outside reporter for the report.
